messages:
lee: heads up — staging canary (canary-12) started showing p99 spikes after the merge from this morning. saw p99 jump 120ms -> ~320ms on 8k token workflows. KV miss rate also spiked. attaching quick flame snippet below. :frowning:
lee: ```
Profile: kernel_choice_v2 + dynamic_batching
p50: 45ms
p95: 130ms
p99: 320ms
kv_miss_rate: 12% (baseline ~2%)
hotspot: kv_lookup + batch_coalescer::flush
```
sam: omg, CI perf job also failed (ci-perf-stable) with the same signature earlier. link: https://ci.redwood/ci-perf/1949876521 :eyes:
ci-bot: [alert] ci-perf-stable: regression detected in p99 latency (+180%). Suspected changes: PR#4912, PR#4920
taylor: I ran a quick git-bisect on the canary image. earliest bad commit is 3f7b2a8 -> PR#4912 (dynamic-batching: change coalescer flush timing + kernel selector weight tweak).
taylor: repro locally with synthetic replay, the batch coalescer now flushes earlier when queue depth drops below `min_batch_factor`, which increases tail KV lookups and prevents effective prefix caching.
maria: ok. is this triggering the canary gating auto-pause? I thought we had an SLO guard on p99 increase >30%.
deploy-bot: rollout: canary-12 -> 5% deployed. gate: slo-checker / p99_over_baseline = 165% -> ACTION: pause rollout.
lee: it did pause, but the pause happened after ~10k requests; we still served errors/tails for some customers. we need both faster detection and an early-warning metric for kv_tail_rate.
sam: action plan proposed: 1) revert PR#4912 from canary (manual rollback) 2) add an early-warning canary metric `kv_prefix_miss_5m` with alert threshold 5% 3) adjust auto-pause to trigger on either p99 or kv_prefix_miss rising for 3 consecutive 1m windows.\
maria: +1 on metric. also add a temporary kernel fallback: if kv_prefix_miss > 5% then force `kernel_choice=v1` for canary instances. that should avoid the new kernel path until we fix batching.
taylor: I can draft a small revert PR and a canary config change. I'll also add an integration test that replays a mix of short/long seqs to CI-perf. that should catch the coalescer-flush regressions.
lee: tt: how urgent? we should rollback the canary and patch the gate today.
taylor: rolling back now. `deploy rollback canary-12 --to-image canary-11` (started)\
deploy-bot: rollback job started (job id rlb-1949876599). estimated completion 2m.
ci-bot: note: adding `kv_prefix_miss_5m` to perf CI dashboards requires a small exporter change. I'll file an infra ticket if you want.
maria: please file ticket and move fast. also update runbook: add step to surface `kv_prefix_miss` in onboarding checklist for canaries.
lee: filed ticket INFRA-7843 for exporter + dash. link: https://infra.redwood/INFRA-7843\
taylor: rollback completed. canary showing p99 back to ~118ms. kv_miss_rate down to ~1.8%.
lee: nice. follow-ups: PR#4912 needs a deeper fix (batch coalescer heuristics + ensure cache priming before early flush). taylor, can you own a small perf patch and a unit test that covers the edge case?
taylor: yeah, I'll own. will also add a protective flag `--strict-cache-priming` that we can flip in staging while testing.
maria: good. i'll update the rollout gate rules — require both p99 and kv_prefix_miss checks for autopause, and lower evaluation window to 1m for canaries. i'll push the gate change after we confirm tests.
sam: thanks y'all. re-open if rollback sees any anomalies. :thumbsup:
